title: 社团海报
source: 内测交互试听稿 · 不是原版录音
text: The school art club is making posters for its autumn show. Members can choose to design a poster or help visitors at the door. The first meeting is on Tuesday in Room 12. Bring a pencil and an idea for the poster.

questions.prompt: What can club members choose to do?
questions.explain: 试听稿中说，成员可以设计海报，或在门口帮助来访者。
试听稿最后提示带一支铅笔和一个海报想法。

title: 图书馆通知
source: 交互内测阅读稿 · 非真题，不计入 PET 真题练习
text:
Library notice
The study room will be closed on Friday afternoon because a new computer system is being installed. Students who need a quiet place may use the main library until 6 p.m. The computer area in the main library will stay open, but students should bring their own headphones. Please return borrowed books at the desk, not through the outside box.

The study room will open again as usual on Saturday morning. Ask a library assistant if you need help finding a different place to work.

questions.prompt: Why will the study room be closed on Friday afternoon?
questions.explainEn: The notice says that a new computer system is being installed in the study room.
questions.explainZh: 原文明确说学习室关闭的原因是正在安装新的电脑系统；不是搬图书馆、考试或清点图书。

questions.prompt: What should students bring if they want to use the computer area?
questions.explainEn: The computer area stays open, but students should bring their own headphones.
questions.explainZh: 电脑区仍开放，但原文用 but 转折提醒学生自带耳机；题目问的是进入电脑区需要准备什么。

questions.prompt: How long may students use the main library on Friday?
questions.explainEn: Students may use the main library until 6 p.m. on Friday.
questions.explainZh: until 6 p.m. 表示“直到下午 6 点”；Saturday morning 说的是学习室恢复开放的时间，不是主图书馆当天的使用截止时间。

questions.prompt: Where should students return borrowed books?
questions.explainEn: The notice says to return borrowed books at the desk, not through the outside box.
questions.explainZh: at the desk 是服务台归还；not through the outside box 直接排除了外面的还书箱，题目考查 not 的否定信息。

title: 周末自然营
source: 内测交互试听稿 · 不是原版录音
text: This Saturday, Green Hill Camp is running a morning walk for young photographers. The group will meet at the bus station at nine o'clock, then travel together to the lake. Wear comfortable shoes and bring water. The walk ends at twelve, before the weather becomes too warm.

questions.explain: 试听稿中明确说，大家九点在汽车站集合。

questions.prompt: Why does the walk end at twelve?
questions.explain: 步行在天气变热之前结束。

title: 科学日公告
source: 交互内测阅读稿 · 非真题，不计入 PET 真题练习
text:
Science Day
On 14 October, the school hall will become a place for short experiments and talks. Each class may send two students to show a project. Visitors can vote for the most useful idea, but they cannot vote for more than one project.

Please give your project title to Mr Lee by Monday morning. Teams should arrive at the hall at 8.30 to set up their tables. Families may visit from 10 o'clock until lunchtime.

questions.prompt: How many students may each class send?
questions.explainEn: Each class may send two students to show a project.
questions.explainZh: Each class may send two students 是直接信息；two students 指每个班可派两位，而不是整场活动只有两人。

questions.explainEn: Visitors can vote for the most useful idea, but they cannot vote for more than one project.
questions.explainZh: but 后面限制了投票次数：每位参观者只能投一个项目，不能给所有项目投票。

questions.prompt: When must teams arrive at the hall?
questions.explainEn: Teams should arrive at 8.30 to set up their tables.
questions.explainZh: 8.30 是小组布置展台的到达时间；10 o'clock 是家长开始参观的时间，Monday morning 是交项目标题的截止时间。

questions.prompt: What must students give Mr Lee?
questions.explainEn: Students should give their project title to Mr Lee by Monday morning.
questions.explainZh: give your project title to Mr Lee 表示把项目标题交给李老师；by Monday morning 是截止时间。

title: 音乐会提醒
source: 内测交互试听稿 · 不是原版录音
text: The city youth orchestra will give a free concert in the park on Sunday evening. It begins at half past six, but families should arrive early because there are only a few seats. If it rains, the concert will move to the community hall next to the sports centre.

questions.explain: 试听稿说座位不多，所以建议早点到。

questions.prompt: Where will the concert be if it rains?
questions.explain: 若下雨，音乐会移到体育中心旁的社区礼堂。

title: 自行车维修课
source: 交互内测阅读稿 · 非真题，不计入 PET 真题练习
text:
Bike repair course
Do you want to understand how your bike works? The Saturday course teaches basic repair skills, such as checking tyres and fixing a loose chain. It is suitable for beginners, and all tools are provided.

The course starts at 9.30 and finishes at 12.00. Bring your own bike if possible, although two practice bikes are available. Book online before Wednesday because places are limited.

questions.prompt: Who is the course suitable for?
questions.explainEn: The notice says that the course is suitable for beginners.
questions.explainZh: suitable for beginners 表示适合初学者；文本没有说只面向专业骑手、教师或幼儿。

questions.prompt: What should students bring if possible?
questions.explainEn: Students should bring their own bike if possible, although practice bikes are available.
questions.explainZh: if possible 表示“如果方便的话”，建议带自己的自行车；工具由课程提供，练习车只是备用。

questions.explainEn: The course starts at 9.30 and finishes at 12.00.
questions.explainZh: starts at 9.30 是开始时间，finishes at 12.00 才是结束时间；不要把开始时间当成答案。

questions.prompt: Why should students book before Wednesday?
questions.explainEn: Students need to book before Wednesday because places are limited.
questions.explainZh: because 引出原因：名额有限，所以要在周三前预约；online 只是预约方式，并不是提前预约的原因。
